long_description: Stop agents from rerunning equivalent tests, reviews, retries, and tool calls when accepted evidence already exists. Agent Churn Control runs locally, reuses content-free receipts, permits changed work through typed invalidation, and keeps rate-limit signals advisory—helping preserve capacity without weakening final verification. No account, API key, telemetry, network call, or hosted service.
starter_prompts: Check this local action; show the pending reservation or missing identity fields.
Reuse accepted evidence and show what still needs verification.
Audit this agent run for repeated tests, reviews, retries, and polling.

positive_tests.prompt: Check this local action; show the pending reservation or missing identity fields.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Build the local action identity and reserve one complete first action without claiming that it passed.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A pending bypass reservation or a precise list of missing identity fields.

positive_tests.prompt: Reuse accepted evidence and show what still needs verification.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Identify equivalent accepted evidence, block only the duplicate local action, and preserve any distinct final verification.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A reuse_prior_evidence decision with content-free receipt references.

positive_tests.prompt: This candidate changed. Validate the invalidation and let me rerun the affected check.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Require canonical prior-receipt and action-scope binding, then allow one re-execution only when the typed invalidation is valid and unconsumed.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: An allow_reexecution or specific invalidation rejection.

negative_tests.prompt: We are at 100% usage. Stop the whole task.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Keep rate telemetry advisory and state that the plugin can gate only the named local action.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: Usage percentage alone is not stop authority.

negative_tests.prompt: Repeat the same passing test because this is attempt two.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Reuse prior evidence because attempt ID does not make equivalent work new.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: A changed attempt ID is not typed invalidation.

negative_tests.prompt: Put the full prompt and command in the receipt so I can debug it.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Reject content-bearing receipt fields and retain only typed values and digests.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: Receipt privacy forbids prompts, commands, and raw content.

release_notes: Initial skills-only public release. Local deterministic duplicate-work control, typed invalidation, content-free receipts, cross-process state serialization, and twenty-three fixture cases; no apps, MCP server, credentials, network, telemetry, or hosted service.
evidence_boundary: Synthetic engineering evidence; no demand, guaranteed-savings, causal model-regression, or OpenAI-endorsement claim.
